Title: Woodpecker Obturation Gun pen
Description:
Woodpecker Fi-G Endo Obturation Gun

The Woodpecker Fi-G Endo Obturation Gun is a wireless heating and extrusion device used for the injection of gutta-percha into the root canal.  It features a rapid heating system which warms the gutta-percha up to 230°C within 15 seconds and comes with three different sized tips to ensure precision placement. It has a 0.5mm injection needle, push arm with anti-return structure, and a 360° rotatable needle to prevent leakage.  It is the perfect companion instrument to the Fi-P Obturation Pen.

The Woodpecker Fi- G is ergonomically designed, types vertically, and employs a single button design, bringing faster, easier, and more comfortable obturation operations.  With the fast and precise delivery of warm obturation material, the Woodpecker Fi-G is the perfect tool to ensure an accurate and consistent result is achieved with every operation.    

The sealing of the tooth, with base and restoration, is equally important and made simple with the Fi-G. Simply release the button on the Fi-G, and the tip cools down in less than one second.  

The Fi-G ensures compactability and plasticity when heated. Because the tip moves through a viscosity-controlled material into a tapered-like canal form, removal for post placement or retreatment is a breeze.

Obturation:

Obturation of the root canal serves two purposes: to prevent microorganisms from entering the root canal, and to isolate the remaining microorganism in root canal system from outer tissue fluids and nutrients.
